implementationNotes:
STATE AT 2026-11-07 (verify against the live tracker and repository first; this note is a pointer, not authority).
WCLI-149 (Ed25519 sign operation, DEC-262 item 2), In Progress. Part 1 LANDED: opum-ai/ward-cli#285 squash d893cb839d5d631e8527aaebf83ddb7dda5dd92a on origin/dev (sign keys as SecretRecord kind ed25519, ward key generate/public, backup exclusion named at backup time, restore prose, refusal as a credential, ADR 0027, pointer amendments to ADR 0003 and 0023). Accepted under DEC-265 after three review rounds; the rounds and the 7575d22 acceptance are on WCLI-149 implementationNotes.
SLICE 2 (sign profile, ward sign) is NOT landed. It is pushed to origin UNREBASED as branch WCLI-149-sign-profile at 2e8ffd15751eeba7a167cf9800049f33fbace96b, no PR. Three commits on base 03104ac (the pre-squash #285 head): 987f80b, ce5e92e, 2e8ffd1. To rebase: git fetch origin, then git rebase --onto origin/dev 03104ac WCLI-149-sign-profile, each command bare. Expected conflicts: src/application/sign.ts, src/contract/errors.ts (both sides add sign_input_refused), src/contract/manifest.ts, docs/adr/0027 (slice 2 rewrites decision (iii) and the status; take slice 2 text but keep #285 round-2 and round-3 wording: run refuses with sign_key_refused, check reports reason sign-key exit 6, profile list shows secret state sign-key exit 0), possibly src/application/profiles.ts (the sign-key secret state and guidance string landed in #285), test/signing.test.ts and .lore/agents/*.toml (re-check capacity after the rebase; narrow with #decision fragments, never raise max_tokens). Then bun run check, lore check, lore validate --strict, node scripts/check-lore-agent-sources.mjs, and open slice 2 as its own PR from dev; do not stack. It needs a DEC-183 review (credentials class; Opus reviewer). Slice 2 content: per-kind snapshot versions (HTTP stays at its current version 3, sign starts at 1, told apart by adapter; DEC-262 a4 and a7), sign profile {adapter sign, key, prefixes base64, 1 to 8, 1 to 64 bytes, empty refused per a5}, ward sign (stdin up to 64 KiB, raw 64-byte signature via RunResult.stdoutBytes, --base64, --json), audited with the existing AuditRecord, nonzero exit plus a stderr line if the completion audit fails (a7), terminal approval prompt for sign, plugin/skills/ward/SKILL.md one sentence (no hash binds it; re-run test/agents.test.ts, test/plugin-manifest.test.ts and node scripts/check-evals.mjs). Status and doctor reporting of sign keys is out, no follow-up (a7).
DEFERRED OPTIONAL ITEMS from the #285 review: docs/runbooks/restoring-a-ward-vault-from-a-backup.md does not mention regenerating and re-enrolling signing keys; excludedSignKeys lists aliases without their project, so two projects with one alias are ambiguous.
LORE-CLI OBSERVATION to report after #285 (now landed): docs/log.md is backfilled by lore sync from branch commits, so it records pre-squash branch SHAs (for example 03104ac) that are not on dev after a squash merge. Leader said it does not block and to report it as a lore-cli observation.
WCLI-21 (Linux headless custody, TPM2-sealed key) is NOT started. DEC-262 (a1) and (a2) govern: build it TPM2 direct (open /dev/tpmrm0, never /dev/tpm0), T26 on jetson, spark unsupported (no TPM2) and reported by presence, doctor distinguishes TPM2 absent, present but not accessible, and blob not user-private. Do not change jetson or spark: giving the daemon user access to /dev/tpmrm0 is an operator host step. Measured read-only on jetson: systemd 255.4, /dev/tpmrm0 tss:tss 660, the user not in group tss. Before the first WCLI-21 implementation commit send the fence packet (paths, tests, ADRs incl. the ADR 0004 Linux-bullet amendment, any TPM library) to the leader; custody code is the DEC-182 credentials class. One task at a time, no stacked PRs. Also replace the non-darwin setup lock fallback in src/adapters/setup-session.ts (see WCLI-21 notes) and pin Secret Service and TPM backends explicitly.
REVIEW WORKTREES that stay (DEC-208): .claude/worktrees/review-285-03104ac, review-285-6d17a9d, review-285-8d67ca9, review-285-5249ae0. Do not remove them.
ENVIRONMENT (DEC-266): a session started before nvm moved node to v24.22.2 carries a dead bin dir on PATH, so lore and quest are not found. Prefix commands with: export PATH=$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.22.2/bin:$PATH; A clean renewal starts without the problem.
Method notes: run gh pr merge, git push and git merge bare, each in its own call; PR checks show zero rows briefly after a push, so re-run gh pr checks; spark access is only through the spark launcher script and jetson through the jetson launcher, read-only, never copy or print the key; quest writes use --actor ward-cli-worker --actor-kind delegated-agent --accountable-human jdnewhouse.
